name: First Thousand
desc: Filed one thousand souls. Somebody has to.

name: Ten Thousand Stamped
desc: The stamp is getting warm.

name: Quota, Technically
desc: Technically met. Don't look too close.

name: A Million Filed
desc: HR sent a card. It was a form.

name: Hundred Million Club
desc: There is no club. There is a spreadsheet.

name: Ten Billion and Counting
desc: Counting is now automated. You are not.

name: Trillion-Soul Milestone
desc: Framed certificate not included.

name: Beyond the Ledger
desc: The ledger ran out of pages years ago.

name: Off the Charts
desc: Legal asked for a chart anyway.

name: Quintillion Processed
desc: The number has stopped meaning anything.

name: Sextillion Souls
desc: Somewhere, an actuary weeps quietly.

name: Beyond Counting
desc: Numbers are now a formality.

name: Hand-Stamped
desc: One hundred souls, by hand, like the old days.

name: Repetitive Stress, Embraced
desc: A thousand stamps. The wrist remembers.

name: Carpal Tunnel Vision
desc: Ten thousand stamps and a very tired wrist.

name: The Stamp Never Stops
desc: One hundred thousand. The stamp is now part of your hand.

name: First Ten Hires
desc: A skeleton crew. Sometimes literally.

name: Fifty on Payroll
desc: Payroll is a suggestion at this point.

name: Two Hundred Strong
desc: The break room ran out of chairs.

name: A Thousand Employees
desc: Nobody knows everyone's name. Not even HR.

name: Five Thousand and Overstaffed
desc: There are more staff than souls, somehow.

name: Twenty Thousand on the Roster
desc: The org chart is now a mural.

name: Dave, Cloned Twenty-Five Times
desc: Dave never leaves. Dave multiplies.

name: Dave Never Leaves
desc: One hundred Daves. HR has stopped asking.

name: Seraphine's Understudies
desc: Twenty-five angels, all equally chipper.

name: Cloud Nine Overtime
desc: A hundred Seraphines. Cloud Nine is out of staff.

name: Gary's Union Local
desc: Twenty-five Garys, all on break simultaneously.

name: The Full Gary Local
desc: A hundred Garys. The union has real leverage now.

name: The Auditor, Duplicated
desc: Twenty-five Auditors. None of them read the file.

name: Audit Committee of One Hundred
desc: A hundred Auditors. Still nobody reads the file.

name: First Five Upgrades
desc: The stapler is faster now. Slightly.

name: Twenty Improvements
desc: The office is unrecognizable. Mostly worse.

name: Fifty Upgrades Deep
desc: Someone approved all of these. Was it you?

name: The Upgrade Never Ends
desc: One hundred upgrades. The office hums now.

name: Two Departments
desc: Welcome to middle management.

name: Three Departments
desc: The org chart needs a second page.

name: Four Departments
desc: You have opinions about all four now.

name: The Whole Afterlife
desc: Every department, under one roof. Poor roof.

name: Books Closed
desc: One fiscal year, closed and filed.

name: Three Years Audited
desc: The Auditor recognizes your face now.

name: Ten Fiscal Years
desc: A decade of eternity, notarized.

name: Twenty-Five Audits Filed
desc: The fiscal years are getting shorter. Nobody says why.

name: Fifty Years, Fifty Audits
desc: The Auditor asked a question this time.

name: A Century of Paperwork
desc: One hundred audits. The tray is bottomless.

name: First Ten Seals
desc: Ten seals of approval. Barely legible.

name: One Hundred Seals
desc: The wax budget has been exceeded.

name: A Thousand Seals
desc: The seal press has its own union rep now.

name: Ten Thousand Seals
desc: Every soul, doubly official.

name: First Perk Purchased
desc: The Ledger has your name in it now.

name: Five Perks Deep
desc: The Ledger is starting to know you too well.

name: Fifteen Perks Unlocked
desc: You've read the fine print. Eventually.

name: Thirty Perks, Fully Invested
desc: The Ledger considers you a regular.

name: The Ledger Remembers You
desc: Every perk on the shelf. The shelf is proud.

name: First Requisition
desc: One personnel card drawn from the pool.

name: Five-Card Roster
desc: A small deck. A dangerous amount of confidence.

name: Ten Cards Collected
desc: The binder is starting to bulge.

name: Twenty Cards Strong
desc: The roster rivals the org chart.

name: The Full Collection
desc: Every card drawn at least once. Somehow.

name: First Executive Card
desc: An executive-tier personnel card. Very rare. Very tired.

name: Three Executives
desc: The C-suite of the afterlife, assembled.

name: The Full Boardroom
desc: Every executive card. The board is now unanimous.

name: First Five-Star Pull
desc: Maximum rank, minimum luck required.

name: Five Five-Star Cards
desc: The RNG has started to feel personal.

name: Ten Five-Star Cards
desc: Luck stopped being the explanation a while ago.

name: Three Cards Equipped
desc: A starting lineup, of sorts.

name: Five Cards Equipped
desc: Every slot filled. Mostly on purpose.

name: Full Roster Equipped
desc: Every equip slot spoken for.

name: First Requisition Drawn
desc: The pool has been dipped into.

name: Ten Requisitions
desc: The pool is starting to look familiar.

name: Fifty Requisitions
desc: The pool operator waves without looking up.

name: Two Hundred Requisitions
desc: The pool operator has your usual ready.

name: Three Dailies Claimed
desc: Three days of showing up.

name: Twenty-One Dailies
desc: Three weeks of showing up. Nobody's counting but the app.

name: Ninety Dailies Claimed
desc: A quarter of dailies, filed on time.

name: A Full Year of Dailies
desc: Every day, stamped. Eternity has a calendar now.

name: Three-Day Streak
desc: Three days running. The Auditor is watching.

name: Seven Days a Week
desc: A full week without a single skipped shift.

name: Thirty-Day Streak
desc: A month unbroken. Legal calls it suspicious.

name: Hundred-Day Streak
desc: One hundred days straight. This is either dedication or a hostage situation.

name: First Ad Watched
desc: Watched an ad for a small bonus. The economy demands it.
